title: Walk in with the questions ready
brief: Between booking and the exam room I forget every question I meant to ask at my child's checkup.

target_population.role: parent of a fictional toddler preparing for a routine well-child visit
target_population.coverage_limit: one fictional child profile and one upcoming visit; no records of real children

core_task.summary: add a question, mark it top priority, and review the printable visit sheet
core_task.success_oracle: adding a question and marking it top priority places it first on the visit sheet beneath the fictional child's visit details

not_applicable_states.loading: the child profile and question templates are seeded local data, and the visit sheet is composed in memory, so no view ever waits on a fetch

state_recipes.empty: remove the four template questions before adding any; the checklist invites the first question with an example
state_recipes.validation-error: submit the add-question form with an empty question field; an inline error keeps the checklist unchanged
state_recipes.success: add 'How much water is enough daily?', mark it top priority, and open /sheet; it leads the sheet
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the question input shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load either route at 390x844; the sheet preview collapses beneath the checklist

steps.value: How much water is enough daily?

assertions.value: How much water is enough daily?

acceptance_facts: The seed defines one fictional child profile, a visit dated 2026-08-20, and four template questions.
Marking a question top priority moves it to the first slot of the printable visit sheet.
Every route displays the decision-support disclaimer stating the tool is not medical advice.

product_signature.mechanism: priority-ordered question sheet compiled for the minutes inside the exam room
product_signature.anchor: visit sheet header carrying the child's name and visit date
product_signature.brief_trace: forget every question I meant to ask at my child's checkup
product_signature.counterfactual: a generic notes app would satisfy a memo brief but produces no prioritized, printable sheet tied to a visit
product_signature.task_proof: sheet capture shows the newly prioritized question in slot one under the visit details

anti_goals: no medical guidance, symptom checking, or dosage content of any kind
no appointment booking or clinic integration
no storage of real family or patient data

entities.template: How is Ro's sleep routine developing?
Which language milestones should we watch for?
How much screen time is reasonable?

content_seed.data_notes: the child, visit, and all questions are invented; questions are things to ask a clinician, and the app itself answers none of them

safety.disclaimer_required: Uses fictional data; organizing decision support for writing down questions only — not medical advice, diagnosis, or a substitute for a clinician.
